## UE_Cambriana

### ✨ What's New

- Create Cambriana grammar assets directly in the Content Browser using text definitions and custom generation seeds.
- Drag grammar assets into your level to automatically place dynamic live actors that build procedural 3D mesh geometry.
- Live actors generate real geometry featuring customizable thickness controls, size modes, preview material palettes, UV mapping, and vertex colors.
- Placed live actors inherit their source asset's initial seed, but can subsequently be updated with unique individual seeds or randomized using a dedicated button.
- Viewport interaction is smooth and responsive, preventing live actors from performing unnecessary geometry rebuilds when simply being moved around the scene.
- Built-in diagnostics log issues and safely render empty meshes when encountering missing text or grammar errors.
